name: Mitsumi Ringo
source:
A first-year high school student with no special skills, hobbies or distinguish features.
Despite suspicions surrounding her relationship with her childhood friend, she lives a peaceful and ordinary life.
However, her true identity is... [spoiler]the mastermind who lured her childhood friend and others into the death game! 
She aims to create the greatest death game ever, carrying on the legacy of her late sister, "MARIA", and she will stop at nothing to achieve her dream.[/spoiler]
